headlines.title_en: UK economic data meets expectations; market focuses more on political situation
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data July 16 - UK May economic data shows GDP grew 0.1% month-on-month, in line with market expectations. The pound held steady after the data release, with market focus remaining on UK politics. Ebury analyst Samuel Edwards said in a report that the latest data highlights the fragility of the UK's economic recovery. Recent escalation of tensions in the Middle East has kept businesses on high alert. Earlier on Thursday, after media reports that UK Prime Minister-elect Burnham may appoint current Home Secretary Mahmood, who is less supportive of expansionary fiscal policy, as Chancellor, EUR/GBP briefly fell to a 13-month low.

headlines.title: 四川：2026上半年GDP达3.36万亿元 同比增4.8%
headlines.summary: 四川省统计局官微消息，根据地区生产总值统一核算结果，2026年上半年四川地区生产总值（GDP）为33629.45亿元，按不变价格计算，同比增长4.8%。其中，第一产业增加值1953.46亿元，同比增长3.6%；第二产业增加值11641.08亿元，增长4.9%；第三产业增加值20034.92亿元，增长4.8%。分产品看，锂离子电池增长62.7%，智能电视增长52.2%，集成电路增长18.6%，工业机器人增长15.7%。

headlines.title_en: Sichuan: H1 2026 GDP reaches 3.36 trillion yuan, up 4.8% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Sichuan Provincial Bureau of Statistics official Weibo - According to unified regional GDP calculations, Sichuan's GDP in the first half of 2026 was 3.362945 trillion yuan, up 4.8% year-on-year at constant prices. Among this, primary industry added 195.346 billion yuan, up 3.6%; secondary industry added 1.164108 trillion yuan, up 4.9%; tertiary industry added 2.003492 trillion yuan, up 4.8%. By product, lithium-ion batteries grew 62.7%, smart TVs grew 52.2%, integrated circuits grew 18.6%, and industrial robots grew 15.7%.

headlines.title: 商务部：将根据国内外氦气供需变化适时调整出口管理
headlines.summary: 商务部新闻发言人何亚东在16日举行的商务部例行新闻发布会上回应我国对氦气进行临时禁止出口管理的有关提问时说，中国是氦气主要进口国，为保障国内供应，商务部、海关总署联合发布公告，决定对氦气实施临时禁止出口管理。该举措符合《中华人民共和国对外贸易法》有关规定和世贸组织规则。后续，我们将根据国内外氦气供需变化，适时调整出口管理政策。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: will adjust helium export management based on changes in domestic and foreign supply and demand
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson He Yadong, at a regular press conference on July 16, responded to questions about China's temporary ban on helium exports, saying China is a major helium importer. To ensure domestic supply, the Ministry of Commerce and the General Administration of Customs jointly issued an announcement deciding to temporarily prohibit helium exports. This measure complies with the Foreign Trade Law and WTO rules. Going forward, we will adjust the export management policy in a timely manner based on changes in domestic and international helium supply and demand. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title_en: A-share market close: ChiNext Index falls back, closes down 2.95%; semiconductor, CPO and other computing power hardware stocks lead declines
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data July 16 - A-share three major indices all fell today, recovering briefly after a lower open with the Shenzhen Component Index turning positive, but declining again in the afternoon. The Shanghai Composite fell below 3900 points in the afternoon, and all three indices fell over 2% by the close. At close, the Shanghai Composite fell 1.85%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 1.97%, and the ChiNext Index fell 2.95%. Shanghai and Shenzhen两市 turnover exceeded 2.4 trillion yuan, with over 2300 stocks rising. By sector, the pharmaceutical sector bucked the trend actively, the film and television sector rose strongly after a lower open, while the semiconductor chain collectively declined, with the semiconductor equipment sector weakening. Sheng Hui Integration (603163) hit limit down for two consecutive days. The memory chip concept continued to adjust, with Demili (300245) hitting limit down for two consecutive days, and GigaDevice hitting limit down.

Film and television stocks rose sharply, with Ruyi Film (HKG: after removing cross-market, unclear ticker) hitting the 2-board limit, and Shanghai Film (601595) and Huanrui Century (000892) hitting limit up. Pharmaceutical stocks continued to rebound, with Harbin Pharmaceutical (600664) hitting 5 consecutive limit ups, and Pian Zai Huang (600436) and Hainan Haiyao (000566) among limit ups. On the downside, semiconductor chip stocks adjusted, with GigaDevice, JCET (600584), and Demili (300245) among many hitting limit down; computing hardware stocks weakened, with HGLaser (000988), China Jushi (600176), and Sinoma Science & Technology (002080) hitting limit down. More stocks fell than rose, with about 2900 stocks declining across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing, with today's turnover at 2.42 trillion yuan. headlines.title: China’s second-quarter GDP growth misses mark, with lowest reading since end of 2022
headlines.summary:
China reported 4.3 per cent gross domestic product growth in the second quarter of 2026 shortly after recording strong, sustained momentum in exports – a contrast underscoring the need for policy support to address weak domestic demand and persistent economic imbalances.
The closely watched GDP figure, released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday, was the slowest quarterly growth rate since the end of 2022. The number fell below the 4.48 per cent forecast from economists...

headlines.title: 商务部回应推动解决安世半导体问题进展
headlines.summary: 商务部新闻发言人何亚东在16日举行的商务部例行新闻发布会上回应推动解决安世半导体进展的有关提问时说，中荷建立开放务实的全面合作伙伴关系10多年来，双边经贸合作不断深化。7月7日，荷兰外贸与发展合作大臣舍尔茨玛访华，王文涛部长与其共同主持召开中荷经贸混委会第18次会议，就中荷、中欧经贸关系坦诚、深入交换意见。中荷双方同意，双方政府应创造良好环境，推动企业通过协商化解纠纷，保障全球半导体产供链安全稳定。(新华社)

headlines.title_en: Commerce Ministry Responds on Progress in Resolving Nexperia Semiconductor Issues
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson He Yadong, at a regular press conference on July 16, responded to questions about progress in resolving the Nexperia Semiconductor issue, saying that since establishing an open and pragmatic comprehensive partnership over 10 years ago, bilateral economic and trade cooperation has deepened. On July 7, Dutch Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation Reinette Klever visited China, and Minister Wang Wentao co-chaired the 18th China-Netherlands Economic and Trade Joint Committee meeting, conducting frank and in-depth exchanges on China-Netherlands and China-EU economic ties. Both sides agreed that governments should create a favorable environment and promote enterprise negotiation to resolve disputes, ensuring the security and stability of the global semiconductor supply chain. (Xinhua News Agency)
